name: lz4
description: Extremely fast compression algorithm with high speed compression and decompression

lz4.description: Ultra-fast compression tool optimized for speed over compression ratio
lz4.usage:
lz4 file.txt
lz4 -d file.txt.lz4
lz4 -9 file.txt
lz4 -c file.txt | process
lz4 -f existing.lz4
